text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic fictional adult male, age 22–26. Individual 1086 x 1448 pixel portrait, vertical 3:4. Perfectly frontal eye-level passport-like head-and-shoulders composition, upper-chest crop. Head upright with zero yaw, pitch or tilt, shoulders level and symmetrical, gaze directly into camera, calm neutral closed-mouth expression. Entire hair and worn headwear visible, approximately 8% white headroom. Solid opaque pure white #FFFFFF background, soft even neutral frontal studio light, realistic 85mm perspective, natural matte skin pores, subtle asymmetry, believable anatomy, dry natural hair and unglossed lips. No oily shine, skin smoothing, CGI, illustration, beauty filter, text, logos, watermark, borders, collage, visible hands or handheld objects. Playful intellectual charm. Dark brown choppy hair, hazel eyes behind thin round dark glasses. Facial features: long narrow face, high forehead, close-set narrow eyes, prominent curved nose, thin lips, pointed chin. Black tee and small silver hoops.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target: the single supplied image is the APPROVED fictional character identity. Generate a new front-facing eye-level ID-photo-composition portrait of this EXACT SAME person. Preserve his facial identity, facial proportions, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, age, skin tone, subtle asymmetry, freckles/stubble, hairstyle and color, clothing and wearable accessories from the supplied image. Do not redesign, beautify, slim the face, or mix identities.
Change ONLY the camera alignment, pose and crop: perfectly frontal face and torso, both shoulders symmetric and level, head upright, zero head tilt, zero yaw, zero pitch, eyes looking directly into the lens at eye level, natural neutral closed-mouth expression. Standard passport-like HEAD AND SHOULDERS crop ending at upper chest; no hands visible. The complete hair and any worn headwear must fit with approximately 8% white space above; center the head horizontally. Natural face proportions with 85mm portrait perspective.
Output ONE individual 1086 x 1448 pixel portrait, exact vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Solid opaque pure white #FFFFFF background, soft even neutral front studio lighting, very faint natural facial shadow, true photographic detail, matte natural skin pores and unglossed lips. Match the source's realistic photographic texture. No oily shine, smoothing, CGI, illustration, beauty filter, text, watermark, collage, frames or handheld objects. This is a character reference portrait, not an actual official ID document.
Character number 10; use only the attached approved identity.
